registered_rule.short_statement: Every eligible inline value site has one exact owner/parent/selector binding, complete descriptor and child types; missing or extra source-less sites reject.
Nominal types and site identities remain exact; aliases delegate declaration bodies without casts and type-order integration preserves all old ranks.
Map uses typed key/value child entries with canonical typed order and duplicate canonical key rejection before interning; native module mapping is full and source-exact.
Only the future pre-capture binder constructs bounded minimal input graphs under0217 full typed equality, canonical height/type/body/child ordering and exact roots.
G references resolve exact typed inputs in their fixed complete carrier; ordinary integers, other arenas, output backedges and synthetic roots never repair missing bindings.
W local/input edges are explicit; external G targets use full typed comparison without W-local height and complete envelope equality includes G and exact tuple.
Complete rank-free declared inputs and genuine native source associations precede immutable G, actual C admission and complete Fact assembly; T4 cannot backfill input ranks.
Structural diagnostics use closed applicable domain/reason/stage/source paths, preserve complete source and never become evaluated port predicates or partial successful graphs.
Successor candidate Subject data may be bound before C but complete Fact use requires genuine source admission and every actual Some C Valid; failures preserve port events without Facts.
Raw ScopeSubject declares its exact Subject input root and all affected Source/Target/Origin/Basis/Witness/Evidence/C references retain explicit G/W domains without output-dependent input identity.
Independent source-derived site/field/variant/node rosters and two-sided omission rejection cover the closed current model; metadata success is not production capture.
Structural binding uses exact successor source/rule/model/report/obligation contents with frozen previous records and current-only refusal of old or mixed identity.

Registered structural staging leaves production binder, full Raw, Scope, normalizer and positive proof/publication/runtime unimplemented or unauthorized; default resource and bounded D4 gates remain separate.
